column1: # Recipe pack: Forge 1.20.x -> NeoForge 1.21.1 (issue #27, Stage 4). Format: tools/apply-recipes.py.
# so Forge packages already read net.neoforged.* here. Every row is a catalogue entry's own Pattern -> Fix;
# replacements that need an import are written fully qualified inline (§V19), so no import block is edited.
# A member rename names its owner (§X7). Order matters within the regex rows (§X4): they run in file order,
#@ 24 auto  ForgeEventFactory / ForgeHooks / ForgeHooksClient became EventHooks / CommonHooks / ClientHooks
#@ 45 auto  the FORGE event bus is the GAME bus
#@ 11 auto  ForgeRegistries.X is BuiltInRegistries.X (singular); lookups are get, not getValue
#@ 22 auto  LivingHurtEvent and LivingAttackEvent are LivingIncomingDamageEvent
#@ 46 auto  defaultDurability is durability; Properties.copy is ofFullCopy
#@ 98 auto  getDimensions is final; override getDefaultDimensions
#@ 32 auto  hurtAndBreak takes the slot, not a break callback
#@ 113 auto  setMaxUpStep is the STEP_HEIGHT attribute (not on known non-living bases: a plain Entity has no attribute map)
#@ 36 auto  ForgeMod reach attributes are vanilla; the rest of ForgeMod is NeoForgeMod
#@ 138 auto  GeckoLib 4.8 flattened the core packages (bare names only where GeckoLib is imported: mods ship their own RenderUtils)
#@ 54 auto  SRG ids the 1.20.1 dictionary does not map (names read from finished ports' own diffs, 2+ uses each)
#@ R18 auto  setCustomClientFactory is gone; MCreator's same-class SpawnEntity constructor goes with it
#@ 117 auto  appendHoverText takes an Item.TooltipContext, not a Level
#@ 105 auto  VertexConsumer builder renamed; endVertex is gone (only in files using the vertex API)
#@ 104 auto  renderToBuffer and ModelPart.render take one packed ARGB int, not four floats
re:void renderToBuffer\((PoseStack \w+, VertexConsumer \w+, int \w+, int \w+), float (\w+), float (\w+), float (\w+), float (\w+)\)\s*\{
#@ 79 auto  Screen.renderBackground takes the render arguments (files whose render method names them mouseX/mouseY/partialTicks)

column2: int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks\)

the body reads player.getItemInHand(hand): useItemOn(ItemStack, BlockState, Level, BlockPos, Player, InteractionHand, BlockHitResult), returns ItemInteractionResult
delete the getMobType() override; put the entity type in #minecraft:undead / arthropod / illager / aquatic; checks become getType().is(EntityTypeTags.X)
many call sites read getMobType() for damage or potion logic: a local MobType enum plus MobType.of(Entity) keeps them (catalogue 30's augment)

a bag of keys: an ItemNbtCompat helper over DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA; write back after every mutation (catalogue 53)
